description: One of the signed-in traveller's plans, day by day: each day's date, town and stops (with each stop's id, time, minutes, category, visitNote (what the traveller does there that day) and note (the place's advisory); a titleless freeform stop is marked role transfer, note or alternative), its bookings (with booked or still to book), and seq, the version to send back with edit_plan as base_seq. Needs sign-in.
name: get_plan
title: Get one of my plans
